gen-dafont-capture-smallz-archivo: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz stamps its big-bodied lowercase across the top. Archivo takes over below with curves that open outward and a commanding x-height, so a full paragraph flows smoothly and feels approachable.
gen-audiowide-gf-julius-sans-one: Tiles with wide grout lines: Audiowide sets futuristic letters with no thick-thin shift, every curve and downstroke matching. Julius Sans One spaces itself out widely, so extended reading drifts by gently.
gen-dafont-conthrax-archivo: Sleek, geometric lines: Conthrax holds every stroke to a single gauge, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals in height. Conthrax is built to grab the eye, while Archivo carries the sentences.
gen-dafont-joystix-fs-merriweather-sans: Joystix spaces out its bold arcade lettering, with stems only a shade heavier than the arms joining them. Merriweather Sans handles the quieter work, its sturdy lowercase and open-eyed e keeping words clear.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-gf-graduate: Minecraftia is familiar and fun, with towering lowercase letters stepping out one character per beat. But Graduate is the one for sustained reading, a bookish serif with generous white between letters.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-graduate: Powerful and ancient, Nordic packs its letters into closed, cramped shapes with one monoweight stroke. But Graduate opens everything up, its dignified letters spaced generously and best at carrying the text.
gen-eater-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its modern letters like pins in a wide board. Eater, dark and aggressive with mild thick-thin shifts, belongs up top in big, brief lines where its personality can show.
gen-dafont-disorder-archivo: Disorder is chaotic and raw, its n arches matching the stems beside them and its glyphs set well apart. Disorder does the shouting, while Archivo does the patient, approachable explaining.
gen-flavors-gf-julius-sans-one: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors gives its diagonals the same heft as its stems, with a stubby, towering x-height. Julius Sans One floats beside it, light and widely spaced, almost whispering.
gen-dafont-quantum-fs-merriweather-sans: Clean and techy, Quantum keeps every curve and straight at the same line width, with loose letterfit. Merriweather Sans then settles in, with sturdy, large-looking lowercase that carries paragraphs comfortably.
